title: Thiazole peptidomimetics as chemical modulators of KRAS gene expression via G-quadruplex stabilization
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00046G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Debasmita Biswas, Ananta Gorai, Sandip Maiti, Ritapa Chaudhuri, Sayantan Pradhan, Jyotirmayee Dash
Bis-thiazole peptidomimetic TTh2 selectively binds and stabilizes the KRAS promoter G-quadruplex, leading to KRAS downregulation and inhibition of MAPK and Akt/mTOR pathways, demonstrating a novel strategy for targeting ''undruggable'' oncogenes.
